title: Baroque Rhetorical Architecture and Emphatic Tropes

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Péter Pázmány (1570-1637) is regarded as one of the creators of the Hungarian literary sentence. His style is characterised by long periodic sentences (*körmondat*), vivid images drawn from everyday life, and sharp antitheses (you know antithesis from C1 Unit 1).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: In modern formal prose, echoing baroque cadence means balancing passionate rhetorical conviction (*pátosz*) with rigorous logical clarity (*logikai fegyelem*).
